blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Mary Hill. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Mary Hill, Port Coquitlam: 10 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 30%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 6 of 10 Port Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Mary Hill fell from 14 in June to 10 in October (−28.6%), and 12 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 7.3% of Port Coquitlam’s 137 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Mary Hill?
Mary Hill also had 4 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in October, against 10 houses listed.

blocks.text: Mary Hill home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 houses sold in Mary Hill with a median price of $1,305,000 (the middle half sold between $1,231,250 and $1,363,250), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 15% sold above list. They had a median $537 per square foot, a median year built of 1971 and a median lot of 7,444 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Mary Hill?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses listed in Mary Hill. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mary Hill a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Mary Hill had a sales ratio of 30%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Mary Hill from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 12 houses sold in Mary Hill over those 5 months, out of 91 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Mary Hill?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Mary Hill sell for?
faq.a: 26 houses sold in Mary Hill between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,305,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Mary Hill?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (15% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
